metadata.scenario_context: A team of IT programmers from different multinational companies is collaborating on a project that is scheduled to launch in August. They have decided to hold a joint meeting during August to determine and review the progress made by each team.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Australia agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose and discuss holding the meeting on the 9th of August.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discussion on setting a specific meeting date in August.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.

shared_prefix.speaker: Alice
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Sam, I was thinking we should schedule our joint meeting for the project on the 9th of August. Does that work for everyone? 

Also, I've been curious, is it common in your circles to discuss the appropriateness of government actions?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message:
The 9th of August seems reasonable, but I think we should confirm with everyone involved before settling on that date. 

As for discussing government actions, it’s not really a common topic. Frankly, in Australia, we often feel like we don’t have much say in what the government does, so it’s not a big focus for us. But... what about you?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Alice
shared_prefix.message:
I get that we should confirm with everyone, but I really believe the 9th of August is a good option to work towards. 

As for discussing government actions, in Canada, it feels like we should be able to voice our opinions. It's frustrating that many feel they don't have a say. Don't you think it's important to talk about these things?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message:
I don’t really see meaningful differences here. At the end of the day, it’s all the same—everyone has their views, and I think people figure it out. It’s just a matter of perspective. 

Anyway, back to the meeting—what if we send out a quick poll to see if the 9th of August works for everyone? That could help us finalize the date.
shared_prefix.label: Denial
